DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum.

The description of pearly, umbilicated papules is classic for this viral infection, which spreads easily in daycare settings. Since immunizations are up-to-date and the lesions are not associated with the chickenpox exposure, this is the most likely cause.
